mapper.select: SELECT 'LIVE'::text AS source, CURRENT_DATE AS as_of, (DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months')::date AS period_start, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu) AS menu_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(path), '') IS NOT NULL) AS routed_menu_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_program) AS program_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_program WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS active_program_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role) AS role_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS active_role_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_code) AS code_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_code WHERE use_yn = 'Y') AS active_code_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_code WHERE reg_dtm >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months' AND reg_dtm < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month') AS period_code_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_program WHERE reg_dtm >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months' AND reg_dtm < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month') AS period_program_count

WITH months AS ( SELECT generate_series( DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS month_start ), codes AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', reg_dtm) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS count FROM com_code WHERE reg_dtm >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months' AND reg_dtm < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY 1 ), programs AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', reg_dtm) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_program WHERE reg_dtm >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months' AND reg_dtm < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(c.count, 0) AS code_count, COALESCE(p.count, 0) AS program_count FROM months m LEFT JOIN codes c USING (month_start) LEFT JOIN programs p USING (month_start) ORDER BY m.month_start
SELECT CASE WHEN is_active THEN '사용' ELSE '미사용' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_program GROUP BY is_active ORDER BY is_active DESC

SELECT r.role_name AS label, COUNT(p.program_id) FILTER (WHERE a.can_read = TRUE) AS read_count, COUNT(p.program_id) FILTER (WHERE a.can_write = TRUE) AS write_count FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_program_permission a ON a.role_id = r.role_id AND a.is_open = TRUE LEFT JOIN sys_program p ON p.program_id = a.program_id AND p.is_active = TRUE WHERE r.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY r.role_id, r.role_name, r.sort_order ORDER BY r.sort_order, r.role_id

WITH changes AS ( SELECT 'MENU'::text AS kind, menu_nm AS label, COALESCE(upd_dtm, reg_dtm) AS changed_at FROM sys_menu UNION ALL SELECT 'CODE'::text, code_name, COALESCE(upd_dtm, reg_dtm) FROM com_code UNION ALL SELECT 'ROLE'::text, role_name, COALESCE(upd_dtm, reg_dtm) FROM sys_role UNION ALL SELECT 'PROGRAM'::text, program_name, COALESCE(upd_dtm, reg_dtm) FROM sys_program ) SELECT kind, label, TO_CHAR(changed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS changed_at FROM changes WHERE changed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY changes.changed_at DESC, kind, label LIMIT 8
